doc: The crop (corn_gen.js): cane stalk, ranked arching leaves, husked ear, silk, tassel — one geometry on the ONE corn_ trim sheet, her baked cob included (peel true stands it up bare on the first ear). Pair with `rows` for a planted field; without rows it volunteers as a wild patch. Crop uniformity: tight baseScale, near-vertical. regionTint: plume art is dark red-brown; a mature field's tassels read tan-straw.
